title: REPORT on human rights and democracy in the world and the European Union’s policy on the matter – annual report 2024
part_text: 2. Insists that the promotion of the economic and political interests of the Member States must be the cornerstone of the EU’s external policy; notes that the world is enormously diverse in terms of political and economic systems, religions and social and economic developments; is of the opinion that states are often prone to human rights interventionism as a means of launching political attacks against other states and drawing attention away from their own human rights violations in the process; rejects any policy that weaponises human rights;
